description:
Which vrats (fasts) fall on which dates: Ekadashi, Pradosh, Purnima, Amavasya, Karwa Chauth and
    others, with the deity, from DharmikVibes' verified festival calendar and DivineAI's vrat list. How a
    vrat is kept is included only once a scholar has checked that text.

from_date.description: ISO start date. Omit for today in India.
from_date.title: From Date

include_weekly.description: Also list the weekday vrats (Somvar, Mangalvar, ...).
include_weekly.title: Include Weekly

to_date.description: ISO end date. Omit for 60 days after the start.
to_date.title: To Date

vrat.description: Only this vrat, for example Ekadashi, Pradosh, Karwa Chauth, Purnima. Omit for all.
vrat.title: Vrat
